title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior emerges, spreads, and persists in a population under peer influence, media messaging, and policy mandates/enforcement.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals influence each other's mask attitudes and behaviors through social network contacts, with strength modulated by tie weight, homophily, and observed peer behavior.

interactions.name: media_influence
interactions.description: Media channels broadcast messages that shift individuals' risk perception and perceived mask effectiveness based on channel reach, bias, intensity, and individual trust.

interactions.name: policy_compliance
interactions.description: Policy authority sets mandates or recommendations; locations enforce; individuals decide to comply based on propensity, perceived costs, and enforcement risk.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contact
interactions.description: Individuals visit locations according to daily schedules, generating contacts; locations record mask use and enforce policy, affecting perceived social norms.

interactions.name: fatigue_and_habit_formation
interactions.description: Over time, individuals may experience compliance fatigue reducing mask use, or habit formation increasing persistence after mandates end.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_by_group
metrics.description: Mask adoption fraction segmented by demographics (age, income, ideology) and location types.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent
metrics.description: Number of days to reach 50% population mask adoption.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate observed and the day it occurs.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_post_policy
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over 30 days after the last mandate ends.

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals complying with mandates while in effect.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Number of enforcement interactions (warnings, fines) executed at locations.

metrics.name: adoption_churn_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which individuals switch between adopting and not adopting per time step.

metrics.name: network_clustering_of_adoption
metrics.description: Clustering coefficient or modularity of mask adoption on the social network indicating polarization.

metrics.name: inequity_index
metrics.description: Inequality of adoption across demographic groups (e.g., Gini or Theil index).

metrics.name: campaign_lift
metrics.description: Incremental adoption attributable to media campaigns versus a no-campaign counterfactual.

metrics.name: risk_correlation
metrics.description: Correlation between external risk signal and adoption rate.
